name: financials_fetch
description: Fetch deep fundamentals for a US ticker via financialdatasets.ai (8 endpoints: profile/statements/segments/13F holders/insider KPI/guidance). Level 2 governed; responses are cached 30 days in Postgres (pay-per-request provider — a cache hit costs nothing).

ticker.description: US ticker, e.g. AAPL (financialdatasets.ai coverage: US equities)
